resources.name: RCWA solver (e.g., S4 or Python rcwa package)

access.notes: Any open‑source rigorous coupled‑wave analysis solver that can handle 1D planar gratings and Drude‑model metals is acceptable.

resources.notes: The solver must compute 0th‑order reflectivity for p‑polarized incident light at 633 nm on the described dielectric‑on‑metal structure.
